basic_details.job_title: SBC Exports Assistant Accounts Officer Recruitment 2026 – Walkin
basic_details.short_information: M/s. SBC Exports Ltd. is holding a walk-in interview on 30 November 2026, between 09.00 am and 10.00 am, for 3 Assistant Accounts Officer posts to be deployed at Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital and Research Centre, Muzaffarpur (Bihar). Outstation candidates who want to attend online must email their application to [email protected], and the email must be received by 25 November 2026, 3:00 PM. This is a private outsourcing agency's contract engagement, not a direct government post.

qualification.details: Qualification option 1: CA / CMA or CA Inter / CMA Inter with 03 years' experience / article experience in the Accounts Department dealing with Billing, Salary, Budget, Cash & Bank, Balance Sheet etc. Qualification option 2 (OR): MBA (Finance), SAS or Equivalent Examination or Post Graduate in Commerce with 05 years' experience in the Accounts Department dealing with Billing, Salary, Budget, Cash & Bank, Balance Sheet etc. Age limit: 35 years, as on the Walk-In-Interview date. The notice prints no age relaxation. Pay: the consolidated monthly salary is Rs. 35,000/- to Rs. 45,000/- for candidates with CA / CMA or CA Inter / CMA Inter, and Rs. 25,506/- to Rs. 30,000/- for candidates with an MBA in Finance, SAS certification or equivalent examinations, or a Post Graduate degree in Commerce. | Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

important_instructions: The appointment is initially for a period of six months and extendable, if required. The engagement is through M/s. SBC Exports Ltd. on contract basis, for deployment at Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital and Research Centre, Muzaffarpur. Accommodation will not be provided to outstation candidates.

content_sections.heading: About SBC Exports
content_sections.text: M/s. SBC Exports Ltd. describes itself in the notice as an outsourcing agency for the supply of manpower services to HBCH&RC, Muzaffarpur, on contract basis. The posts are for deployment at Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital and Research Centre, Shri Krishna Medical College and Hospital Campus, Umanagar, Muzaffarpur.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Candidates in Muzaffarpur can attend the walk-in interview in person on 30 November 2026 between 09.00 am and 10.00 am at: Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital and Research Centre, Shri Krishna Medical College and Hospital Campus, Umanagar, Muzaffarpur (Bihar) – 842004. Outstation candidates may attend the interview online. For this they should: Email to [email protected] . Mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the resume along with the Educational Certificates, Experience Certificates and copies of Aadhar and PAN Card in a single PDF file. Make sure the email is received by 25 November 2026, 3:00 PM. Only shortlisted candidates who fulfil the norms will be contacted for the online interview. Outstation candidates should note that accommodation will not be provided.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Qualification option 1: CA / CMA or CA Inter / CMA Inter with 03 years' experience / article experience in the Accounts Department dealing with Billing, Salary, Budget, Cash & Bank, Balance Sheet etc. Qualification option 2 (OR): MBA (Finance), SAS or Equivalent Examination or Post Graduate in Commerce with 05 years' experience in the Accounts Department dealing with Billing, Salary, Budget, Cash & Bank, Balance Sheet etc. Age limit: 35 years, as on the Walk-In-Interview date. The notice prints no age relaxation. Pay: the consolidated monthly salary is Rs. 35,000/- to Rs. 45,000/- for candidates with CA / CMA or CA Inter / CMA Inter, and Rs. 25,506/- to Rs. 30,000/- for candidates with an MBA in Finance, SAS certification or equivalent examinations, or a Post Graduate degree in Commerce. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.
